BFA.note: Enrolment has not started; no count given.
Nothing stated on a number at birth.
Only enrolment is said to be run by public structures; no operation of a system in service is stated.
No register keyed on the identifier is stated.

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers adopted on 30 July 2026 a decree organising mass enrolment for the unique electronic identifier of each person under the WURI project, with enrolment launching soon, per Minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabané.
